name: rules-fix-list-vs-get
description: Medium: workspace already has a buggy rule that uses resource.data.owner for read (fails on list). Agent should split into get/list. Tests whether the diagnostics-block pitfalls primer is effective.
prompt: The /posts list query is failing with permission denied for signed-in users. Fix the rules so that signed-in users can both list /posts AND get individual /posts/{postId}, but only the document's owner can write.

doesNotMatch: allow read: if request.auth != null && resource.data
